    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) FROM order_payments op2 WHERE op2.order_id = op1.order_id) > 1 THEN payment_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(payment_value), 2) AS pct_varios_metodos
FROM 
    order_payments op1
JOIN 
    vw_pedidos_validos ON op1.order_id = vw_pedidos_validos.order_id
